violated_contract: A predicate that inspects a raised exception to classify it — retryable contention, expected failure, retryable status — must walk the error's full causal graph, not only the direct `__cause__`. An `except:`-block re-raise without `from` places the real cause on `__context__`, and exception groups carry members under `.exceptions`; a cause-only walk treats those wrapped forms as unrelated errors, so a retryable SDK abort fails fast instead of retrying, or an expected class propagates unhandled.
canonical_prevention: Classify raised exceptions through a shared traversal that visits `__cause__`, `__context__`, and exception-group members with a visited-id guard against cycles, matching both the target type and its documented status-code forms.
